scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Shramik Dirghayu Sahayata Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be registered with the labor board
For serious illness benefit, the worker must have been registered for at least three years
benefits_summary: One-time medical assistance up to ₹20,000 for accidents or serious illness, plus additional allowances for vision, dental, hearing, and wage reimbursement for hospitalization.
